data.text:
A.S.Assees vs The Muvattupuzha Municipality on 13 December,
2024 
Wp(C) No.43415/2024 1/4 Order Date : 13-12-2
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice Ziyad Rahman A.A.
 Friday, the 13th day of December 2024 / 22nd Agrahayana, 1946 
 Wp(C) No. 43415 Of 2024 
 Petitioner:
 A.S.Assees,Aged 65 Years, S/O J.K.Saidali (Late), Ambadan House,
 Kanjirakkad, Rayonpuram P.O., Perumbavoor, Ernakulam District., Pin
 - 683543
 Respondents: 
 1. The Muvattupuzha Municipality, Municipal Office, Muvattupuzha Old
 Bridge Rd, Thottumkalpeedika, Muvattupuzha,Ernakulam District, 
 Represented By Its Secretary,Pin - 686673 
 2. The Secretary, Muvattupuzha Municipality, Municipal Office,
 Muvattupuzha Old Bridge Rd, Thottumkalpeedika,
 Muvattupuzha,Ernakulam District., Pin - 686673
 3.  THE DISTRICT TRANSPORT OFFICER, KERALA STATE ROAD TRANSPORT  CORPORATION, MUVATTUPUZHA P.O., ERNAKULAM DISTRICT., PIN - 686673  Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to direct the 2nd respondent to take immediate steps to remove the  shed which was constructed illegally and to stop the functioning of the  shed without license in the waiting area provided for the passengers in  the KSRTC Bus Stand Building at Muvattupuzha by implementing Exhibits P-2  and P-3 forthwith, pending disposal of the writ petition.
 This petition coming on for orders upon perusing the petition and  the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of  M/S.SAJEEV KUMAR K.GOPAL, ANN SUSAN GEORGE, ASWATHY BABU & GOPIKA S. NAIR  Advocates for the petitioner, SRI.T.R.RAJAN, STANDING COUNSEL for the  respondents 1 & 2 and of M/S. RAJAN T.R. & P.C.CHACKO Advocates for the  respondent 3, the court passed the following:
 WP(C) No.43415/2024 2/4 Ord  ZIYAD RAHMAN A.A., J.
 ========================
 W.P(C) No.43415 of 2024  ========================
A.S.Assees vs The Muvattupuzha Municipality on 13 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149423866/
1  Dated this the 13th day of December, 2024  ORDER Admit.
2. Sri .T.R. Rajan, the learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the respondents 1 and 2. Sri. Akhil Suresh, the learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3rd respondent. 
3. The reliefs sought in the writ petition is to direct the 2 nd respondent to remove the shed wherein a tea shop is being conducted in the KSRTC bus stand. Today this writ petition was taken up along with W.P(C) No.44563/2024, filed by the person who is conducting the said shop and the following interim order was passed:
"Admit.
2. Sri.T.R. Rajan, the learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the respondents 1 and 2. Sri.Akhil Suresh, the learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 3rd respondent. 
3. Considering the fact that, the petitioner herein is conducting a tea shop on the basis of Ext.P1 agreement executed between the petitioner WP(C) No.43415/2024 3/4 Order Date : 13-12-2024 and the KSRTC and also that, the petitioner has obtained Ext.P4 from the Department of Industries and Commerce, under Kerala Micro Small Medium Enterprises Facilitation Rules, 2020 to set up a service enterprise, I am inclined to pass an interim order. Moreover, the petitioner has also obtained Ext.P5 license from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India as well. Besides, it is an undisputed fact that the petitioner has been conducting the shop since 2022. In such circumstances, there shall be an interim order staying further proceedings pursuant to Ext.P6 for a period of two months. 
A statement/counter affidavit shall be placed on record by the respondents within three weeks. Post on 24.01.2025." 
In the light of the above, no interim order can be passed in this writ petition. The respondent shall file a statement in response to the averments contained in the writ petition. 
Sd/-
